description:
You are a Quality Assurance Manager at an automotive parts supplier conducting the end-of-quarter quality review in Odoo 17 (http://localhost:8069, login: admin / admin). You must triage the quality alert backlog by completing all of the following actions:

1. Close three resolved alerts by moving them to the Done stage: "Cabinet Door Hinge Misalignment", "Acoustic Panel Bonding Failure", and "Cabinet Coating Thickness Non-Uniform" (all currently in the In Progress stage).
2. Escalate the alert "Chair Armrest Cracking" by changing its priority from High to Urgent.
3. Escalate the alert "Loose Hardware on Shelf Unit" by changing its priority from Normal to High.
4. Add a corrective action to the alert "Desk Laminate Delamination" with the following text: "Contacted supplier for batch recall of DK-2024-055. Applied heat-resistant adhesive reformulation from materials engineering team. Reworked 25 affected units with new adhesive compound. 100% bond strength test conducted — all reworked units passed 72-hour humidity chamber test."
5. Create a new quality alert titled "Q4 2024 Quality Review - Open Action Items" with description: "End-of-quarter quality management review. Three In-Progress alerts closed after verification of corrective actions. Two alerts escalated based on severity reassessment. Remaining open items require continued monitoring in Q1 2025." Set its priority to Normal.
